run_reward_evaluation: run the CLI tool to compute dice rearrangement reward from camera images and a goal pattern
load_camera_parameters: load camera calibration parameters from YAML files using trifinger_simulation.camera.load_camera_parameters
generate_goal_mask: generate goal masks from camera info and a goal pattern using rearrange_dice.generate_goal_mask
evaluate_state: evaluate the dice rearrangement state and compute reward using rearrange_dice.evaluate_state
segment_image: segment light blue objects from camera images using py_lightblue_segmenter.segment_image
